extraction.notes: No official 2027 or 2026 youth summer program information was found. Official archived pages advertise Kids Yoga & Art Summer Camp (August 5–9, 2024), Mindful Mornings – Movement + Making (July 2024), and Summer Kids Yoga + Art (June–July 2024), but these older offerings were not used as 2026 or 2027 cards. A Pre-teen/Teen Yoga & Art Summer Pop-Up page was also found, but its date could not be verified from the accessible text. Several archived event pages returned no readable body when opened; search results supplied some archived details. The empty cards array does not establish that the provider has stopped offering summer programs.
